title: Automatic update not finding updates anymore
symptom: When tapping 'check for updates', a toast message reports that xdrip checks for updates, but nothing happens afterwards, even though the user is not on the latest build. The automatic check also does not provide results.
cause: The update-check service (xdrip-plus-updates.appspot.com) was not recognizing newer releases due to recent changes to the CI server.
fix: The issue was resolved by fixing the CI server; the nightly update channel should be working again.
evidence_quote: jamorham posted at gitter: "Recent changes to the CI server caused the issue, the nightly update channel should be working again now." I can confirm that it works, now.
